function @draw_abc($abccx:number,$abccy:number, $abccol:number, $abcspeed2:number)
	$abccol = color(color_r($abccol),color_g($abccol),color_b($abccol),60)
	if color_r($abccol)>0
		$abcspeed=0
	else
		$abcspeed=0.34*$abcspeed2
	var $abcSCALE_TIME = 50000
	var $abcN = 250
	var $abcu = time / $abcSCALE_TIME
	var $abcrot = $abcu * 0.8 * sin(time*$abcspeed/1000)  

	for 0, $abcN ($i)
		var $abcp = $i / $abcN
		var $abcr = 280 * $abcp
		var $abctheta = 8 * pi * $abcp
		var $abcswirl = 30 * sin(3*$abcp + $abcu)
		var $abctight = 1 - 0.3 * $abcp
		var $abcx = ($abcr * $abctight + $abcswirl) * cos($abctheta)
		var $abcy = ($abcr * $abctight + $abcswirl) * sin($abctheta)
		var $abcxr = $abcx * cos($abcrot) - $abcy * sin($abcrot)
		var $abcyr = $abcx * sin($abcrot) + $abcy * cos($abcrot)
		var $abcf = sin($i * 12.9898 + $abcu * 6)
		if $abcf > 0
			$screen.draw_circle($abccx + $abcxr*0.082, $abccy + $abcyr*0.082, 1, $abccol)	
function @timecalc()
	$days = floor(time / 86400)

	$year = 1970

	while 1==1
		var $yearDays = 365 + (($year % 4 == 0 and $year % 100 != 0) or ($year % 400 == 0))
		if $days < $yearDays
			break
		$days = $days - $yearDays
		$year = $year + 1
	array $monthLengths:number
	var $leap = (($year % 400 == 0) or (($year % 4 == 0) and ($year % 100 != 0)))
	if(!$alreadydone)
		for 0,12 ($i)
			$alreadydone=1
			$monthLengths.append(31)
			$monthLengths.append(28 + $Leap)
			$monthLengths.append(31)
			$monthLengths.append(30)
			$monthLengths.append(31)
			$monthLengths.append(30)
			$monthLengths.append(31)
			$monthLengths.append(31)
			$monthLengths.append(30)
			$monthLengths.append(31)
			$monthLengths.append(30)
			$monthLengths.append(31)
	$month = 1

	while $days >= $monthLengths.($month - 1)
		$days = $days - $monthLengths.($month - 1)
		$month = $month + 1

function @rainbowgenerator()
	$h = (time * 0.5) % 1

	$tr = (sin(2 * pi * $h) + 1) / 2
	$tg = (sin(2 * pi * ($h + 1/3)) + 1) / 2
	$tb = (sin(2 * pi * ($h + 2/3)) + 1) / 2
	
	$rainbow = color($tr*255,$tg*255,$tb*255)


function @roundRect($rndX1:number, $rndY1:number, $rndX2:number, $rndY2:number, $rndCol:number, $rndround:number)
	var $rndW = $rndX2 - $rndX1
	var $rndH = $rndY2 - $rndY1
	
	$screen.draw_circle($rndX1 + $rndround - 1, $rndY1 + $rndround - 1, $rndround, $rndCol)
	$screen.draw_circle($rndX2 - $rndround, $rndY1 + $rndround - 1, $rndround, $rndCol)
	$screen.draw_circle($rndX1 + $rndround - 1, $rndY2 - $rndround, $rndround, $rndCol)
	$screen.draw_circle($rndX2 - $rndround, $rndY2 - $rndround, $rndround, $rndCol)
	
	$screen.draw_line($rndX1+$rndround,$rndY1,$rndX2-$rndround,$rndY1,$rndcol)
	$screen.draw_line($rndX1+$rndround,$rndY2-1,$rndX2-$rndround,$rndY2-1,$rndcol)
	$screen.draw_line($rndX1,$rndY1+$rndround,$rndX1,$rndY2-$rndround,$rndcol)
	$screen.draw_line($rndX2-1,$rndY1+$rndround,$rndX2-1,$rndY2-$rndround,$rndcol)
	var $rnddisx = $rndX2 - $rndX1
	var $rnddisy = $rndY2 - $rndY1
	for 0,$rnddisx ($i)
		$screen.draw_rect($rndX1+$rndround, $rndY1+1, clamp($rndX1+$i+$rndround ,0, $rndX1+$rnddisx-$rndround) , $rndy2-1, black)
	for 0,$rnddisy ($i)
		$screen.draw_rect($rndX1+1, $rndy1+$rndround, $rndx2-1, clamp($rndy1+$i+$rndround ,0, $rndy1+$rnddisy-$rndround), black)
		

	
function @drawcorners($size : number, $cordis : number)
	$size = $size + $cordis
	$screen.draw_line($cordis,$cordis,$cordis,$size,white)
	$screen.draw_line($cordis,$cordis,$size,$cordis,white)
	
	$screen.draw_line($screen.width()-$cordis,$screen.height()-$cordis,$screen.width()-$cordis,$screen.height()-$size,white)
	$screen.draw_line($screen.width()-$cordis,$screen.height()-$cordis,$screen.width()-$size,$screen.height()-$cordis,white)
	
	$screen.draw_line($screen.width()-$cordis,$cordis,$screen.width()-$cordis,$size,white)
	$screen.draw_line($screen.width()-$cordis,$cordis,$screen.width()-$size,$cordis,white)
	
	$screen.draw_line($cordis,$screen.height()-$cordis,$cordis,$screen.height()-$size,white)
	$screen.draw_line($cordis,$screen.height()-$cordis,$size,$screen.height()-$cordis,white)
	
	
function @drawbattery($cordis: number, $size:number, $bat : number, $col:number)
	$screen.draw_rect($cordis+1, $screen.height()-($cordis+$size)  ,$screen.width()-$cordis ,  $screen.height()-($cordis), white)

	$size = $size -2
	$bat = $bat * 0.93
	$bat = $bat + 0.07
	$size = $size -1
	for 0,$size ($temp)
		$screen.draw_rect($cordis + 2, $screen.height()-($cordis+$size)- 2   ,($bat * $screen.width())-$cordis-1 ,  $screen.height()-($cordis) - 1 -$temp, $col)

function @ispointincircle($xt:number,$yt:number, $middlex:number, $middley:number, $circleradius:number) : number
	if sqrt( pow($middlex - $xt,2) + pow($middley - $yt,2)) < $circleradius
		return 1
	else
		return 0
